{{Quote|Emperor of numberless worlds... ''Lord Vader's'' throne still remains empty. Have you now come to take his place and ''join us''?&hellip; The doomed flesh you wear has yielded to ''necrosis''. This clone body ''cannot'' be saved.|The Dark Lord of the Sith, to Palpatine|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
The [[Mummy/Legends|mummified]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemically]]-preserved remains of this<ref name="EE 2" /> '''Dark Lord'''<ref name="EE audio" /> were located within the [[Hall of Judgment (Korriban)|Hall of Judgment]] in the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] at the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="EE 2" />

==Biography==
===Dark Lord of the Sith===
{{Quote|Yes, T'iaz. These mummified ancients are preserved by the very ''alchemy'' that made them ''outcasts''.|Palpatine, to T'iaz|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual served as a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]].<ref name="EE audio" /> The [[Death/Legends|deceased]] body of the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], which remained untouched by time, was preserved by the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] within the [[Hall of Judgment (Korriban)|Hall of Judgment]] in the [[Great Temple (Korriban)|Great Temple]] at the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="EE 2" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Your spirits guided me back to this life when I was ''destroyed'' by Vader&hellip;and by his ''children''&hellip;My aging clone body will soon ''die''. I need healing&hellip; ''now''.|Palpatine, to the Dark Lord of the Sith|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
[[File:VadersThrone-EE2P5.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The ancient Dark Lord offering Vader's throne to Palpatine.]]
After [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] perished aboard the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]], the ancient Dark Lord and at least three [[Unidentified Dark Lord 2 (Great Temple)|other]] [[Unidentified Dark Lord 3 (Great Temple)|deceased]] [[Unidentified Dark Lord 4 (Great Temple)|Sith spirits]] aided Palpatine in his journey out of [[Chaos/Legends|Chaos]] back to the living plane of existence and into a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] body.<ref name="EE 2" />

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the reborn Palpatine visited the Great Temple, seeking counsel from the spirits of his [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] predecessors in order to restore his decaying clone body. As they traveled through the ancient Sith crypt, the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[T'iaz]] felt the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] power emanating from the place. Palpatine explained to him that the ancient Dark Lords were preserved by the [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] that made them [[Exiles|outcasts]]. The Dark Lord doubted his success and offered him [[Tomb of Darth Vader|Vader's tomb]], but Palpatine declined and instead demanded to be healed. The spirit suggested Palpatine to gaze into the [[oracle stone]], through which Palpatine learned that the only way for him to survive would to to [[Essence transfer|transfer his spirit]] into [[Anakin Solo]], the newborn son of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]. The other spirits gave Palpatine counsel and bid him farewell a final time.<ref name="EE 2" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Gaze into the ''oracle stone''&hellip;|The Dark Lord of the Sith, to Palpatine|<ref name="EE 2" />}}
The Dark Lord of the Sith was equipped with dark armor plates and wore a [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. An oracle stone was held in their hands.<ref name="EE 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|tying the Emperor's incapcitated state and shortage of clones in SW Missions: Vader's Return with the trip to Korriban shortly after Yavin mentioned in Empire's End #2|[[Abel G. Peña]]|<ref name="jcf">{{JCFCite|url=posts/3425564|board=Literature|thread=The Emperor's Pawns article (was: Gamer #5 stuff @ TOS!!!)|user=[[Abel G. Peña|Halagad_Ventor]]|date=2001-07-16|time=9:22 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200420171538/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-emperors-pawns-article-was-gamer-5-stuff-tos.3223225/page-4#post-3425564}}</ref>}}
The Dark Lord, albeit unnamed, first appeared in the [[1995]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Empire's End 2|''Empire's End'' 2]], written by [[Tom Veitch]] and illustrated by [[Jim Baikie]].<ref name="EE 2" /> The character was identified as one of the "Dark Lords of ages past" in the [[Empire's End (audio drama)|''Empire's End'' audio drama]], which included four distinct voices and multiple background voices.<ref name="EE audio" />

The article ''[[The Emperor's Pawns]]'', published in [[2001]]'s [[Star Wars Gamer 5|''Star Wars Gamer'' 5]] and written by [[Abel G. Peña]] and [[Juan Schwartz]], expanded on Palpatine's visit to Korriban shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] mentioned in ''Empire's End'' 2. It is said that he "enraged the mummified Sith by demanding dark side knowledge."<ref name="TEP">{{GamerCite|5|The Emperor's Pawns}}</ref> It is unclear whether the mummified Sith mentioned are meant to be the Dark Lords in the Great Temple from ''Empire's End'' 2.

===Inconsistencies===
[[File:Jedi_exile_JMGD.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Three unidentified Exiles arrive on Korriban.]]
In the comic, Palpatine explains that the mummified ancients were [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] for practicing alchemy, which suggests they were affiliated with<ref name="EE 2" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Exiles]], a claim supported by the [[1994]] comic book [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]], where [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]] mentions that the mummified remains of the Exiles were preserved forever on Korriban.<ref name="DLOTS 1">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 1]]</ref> The 1994 comic book [[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]] depicts possibly at least fourteen thrones in the Great Temple on Korriban,<ref name="DLOTS 3">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 3|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> contradicting the twelve Dark Jedi established by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref> This article refrains from linking the Dark Lord with the Exiles.
